newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates see-saw, end higher.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates see-saw, end higher.

text.p: Pakistani money rates fluctuated in a narrow band before ending slightly up on Tuesday after an auction of six-month federal bonds, dealers said.
Onvernight funds were initially offered at 10 percent but rates soon rose to 13.50 percent, a dealer at KASB & Co said. The day closed with borrowers squaring off at 13 percent.
In the bond auction, the State (central) Bank of Pakistan received bids worth a total of 3.277 billion rupees with bids ranging from 14.99 to 16.4995 percent, the dealer said.
